name: copilotkit
summary: I successfully completed all the setup and configuration steps from the CopilotKit quickstart: created the Next.js app, installed the three CopilotKit packages, set up the `.env` file, created the `app/api/copilotkit/route.ts` runtime endpoint, and updated both `app/layout.tsx` and `app/page.tsx` with the provider and sidebar components. TypeScript type-checking demonstrably passed (`npx tsc --noEmit` returned exit code 0 with no errors). However, I had to deviate from the docs by importing `@copilotkit/react-core/v2/index.css` instead of the documented `@copilotkit/react-core/v2/styles.css` because the latter did not exist in the installed package. The build itself was repeatedly killed by the sandbox's memory limits—Next.js 16.3.0 with Turbopack consumed too much RAM and got OOM-killed before completing, so I could not verify the final promised outcome of a working built and served app.

installed.evidence: added 856 packages, and audited 1222 packages in 2m

first_call.evidence: Killed (exit 137) during next build; no server started or API call succeeded

verified.evidence: Build repeatedly killed with 'Killed' and never produced a served app
